verses.text: 212. Over the centuries, Israel’s faith was able to manifest and deepen realization of the riches contained in the revelation of the divine name. God is unique; there are no other gods besides him. (Cf. Isa 44:6.) He transcends the world and history. He made heaven and earth: “They will perish, but you endure; they will all wear out like a garment … but you are the same, and your years have no end.” (Ps 102:26–27.) In God “there is no variation or shadow due to change.” (Jas 1:17.) God is “He who Is,” from everlasting to everlasting, and as such remains ever faithful to himself and to his promises.
